stops.name: Oeschinen Lake
stops.quote: From here, you can either take the Cable car walk up to the shore of Lake Oeschinen.
stops.english: From here, you can either take the Cable car walk up to the shore of Lake Oeschinen.

stops.name: mountain coaster
stops.quote: Rushing down the mountain on the 750 meter long mountain coaster is fun for the whole family!
stops.english: Rushing down the mountain on the 750 meter long mountain coaster is fun for the whole family!

stops.name: Oeschinensee Mountain Restaurant
stops.quote: Oeschinensee Mountain Restaurant (on the lakeshore): “Open” self-service daily from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
stops.english: Oeschinensee Mountain Restaurant (on the lakeshore): “Open” self-service daily from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

stops.name: Öschibach
stops.quote: Be it the hiking trail in the forest high above the Öschibach (A) or the two mountain trails (B, F) along the Cable car with perfect views of the Kandertal valley.
stops.english: Be it the hiking trail in the forest high above the Öschibach (A) or the two mountain trails (B, F) along the Cable car with perfect views of the Kandertal valley.
